sar.reason: R9: an undocumented pattern repeated across five customers' cards.
sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-03 and 2016-12-04 the institution observed six purchase, refund and repurchase cycles on card DEMO-C6099-K1 at a single merchant. Each cycle completed within minutes and was driven by a headless automation browser behind an anonymizing proxy. The same automation device performed identical cycles on four cards belonging to other customers. The activity does not match any documented fraud pattern and appears designed to exploit refund processing timing. Net exposure across the affected episode on the subject card is $1,287.30. The institution has declined further attempts, opened a case, placed the connected cards under monitoring and escalated the pattern to an analyst.

stop_reason: Coordination across five cards settled the verdict; no evidence request could change the required report.
